from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Dividers are the rows/columns with a majority of cells unlike the tile fill.
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(x != fill for x in row) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The globally most common non-fill color is the repeated divider framework.
    framework = max((v for v in counts if v != fill), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            vals = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                    grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]])
            row.append(vals[0] if len(set(vals)) == 1 and vals[0] not in (fill, framework) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    active = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != fill]
    if not active:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in active), max(r for r, c in active)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in active), max(c for r, c in active)
    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
